save_ocr_log_help: Disabled by default. When enabled, saves OCR input images and recognized text for debugging.
quick_loadout_enable_help: Equip preset souls and deploy the preset from the in-battle quick loadout panel; skips the legacy soul switch and battle preset, then applies the team-lock state from general battle settings
quick_loadout_mode_help: mode_number selects by group and preset number; mode_ocr selects by group and preset name
quick_loadout_group_number_help: Preset group number in the quick loadout panel
quick_loadout_preset_number_help: Preset number in the selected group
quick_loadout_group_name_help: Preset group name used in OCR mode
quick_loadout_preset_name_help: Preset name used in OCR mode
quick_loadout_custom_preset_enable_help: Select quick-loadout presets by stage name; deploy the preset and equip its souls once for each new boss challenge
quick_loadout_custom_preset_help: Format: boss_name:("group number or name","preset number or name"); separate entries with semicolons; ALL matches every monster not explicitly configured; OCR mode treats both values as names
start_loop_help: One-shot request, not a permanent switch: it is read once and turned off automatically. Both instances need it on (one leader, one member) with team sync enabled.
loop_rounds_help: One round = one Orochi batch + one full Realm Raid run.
loop_target_min_help: The leader draws the batch size once between min and max; the member uses the same number. Equal values mean a fixed count. Min must not exceed max (checked when the loop starts).
ap_limit_help: Minimum Stamina climb battles per run (range lower bound). Equal to the maximum means a fixed count; both 0 skips Stamina climb. A battle with a Penta Pass still counts as 1.
ap_limit_max_help: Maximum Stamina climb battles per run (range upper bound). Each new run draws one integer in [min, max] as the target. Requires 1 <= min <= max, or both 0; invalid ranges are rejected before the task starts.
welfare_mode_help: When on, the Dokan task runs the welfare flow instead (normal score / refresh limit / owner-battle settings are ignored): uses all remaining chances today (at most two), applies the one-click preset once, only opens Xin dokans whose defender count reaches the threshold, closes the game right after pressing Prepare, returns 10 minutes later to abandon, votes Rematch and waits 2 minutes before the next one. Requires HandleError to be enabled. Off by default.
welfare_min_people_help: Only open a dokan whose defender count is greater than or equal to this value (default 100). Welfare mode only; must be an integer >= 1.
loop_target_max_help: Upper bound of the batch size (1-999). Values outside the range are not saved.
